Question.description: A model representing one pub trivia question

question.description: A multiple choice pub trivia question. Max 1-2 sentences.
question.title: Question

choices.description: A list of possible answers to the question. *EXACTLY ONE* choice must be the correct answer. The others should should be incorrect but also seem feasible.
choices.title: Choices

answer_idx.description: The zero-based index of the correct item from the choices list.
answer_idx.title: Answer Idx

topic.description: The category that best fits the question's main topic.
topic.title: Topic

tags.description: A list of  1-2 word tags that help further characterize the topic of the question. Examples: 'sci fi', 'famous buildings', 'deceased people', 'cinematic villians', 'robots', 'medicine', 'business' etc. These tags will help the quiz-master agent look up thematically appropriate questions for a given theme.
tags.title: Tags
